proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12613 *śaitala gives Kumaoni selo cold and, in the addendum, Western Pahari śeḷo cold. The e-vowel and l-bearing forms match this branch rather than *śaitalya coldness. Exact survey form selo is preserved.
